notes: No cumulative file or directory candidate cap, no top-k candidate truncation.
V2 starts routing from top-level or virtual module cards; a lossy repository-root summary cannot prune the whole tree.
Semantic path retrieval symmetrically expands a frozen general code vocabulary including filesystem/fs and websocket/ws.
Retrieval still requires two semantic query tokens or a token present in <=2% of paths; no fixed result count is used.
Adaptive V2 unions semantic retrieval and hierarchy candidates without same-directory sibling expansion.
Final selection uses the same >=0.65 OR top-1%-with-ties rule as V1, applied after scoring, not as a candidate cap.
Transport max_candidate_bytes=48000 is a batch payload partition, not a logical candidate budget.
The prior all-file concurrency baselines come from source run 36155715068 and are not paid for again.
Cold adaptive has independent calls; quality arms share only exact semantic batch responses. Cached wall time is not standalone latency.
Single-repeat mechanism regression on the same nine diagnostic tasks; no stability or fresh-generalization claims.
